name: Greater Charitable Foundation Equity Scholarship
summary: Multi-year scholarship for UON undergraduates whose study is affected by financial hardship or regional or remote disadvantage.
key: A total benefit of up to $31,818, paid as $5,303 each semester.
who: Enrolled in an eligible UON undergraduate degree
Study affected by financial hardship and/or regional or remote disadvantage
how: Apply through the online portal (PDF uploads only)
catches: Paid for up to 3 years subject to ongoing eligibility
